name: a reorderable list settles into a custom order
looks: A headline claims the order is yours to choose. A short list of labelled rows sits beneath it, the top rows marked pinned, the rest carrying a small drag handle, as if ready to be picked up and moved.
build: Rows fade/rise in top to bottom on a short even stagger; the pinned rows get a small badge that pops in a beat after the row lands; drag handles are a static icon, implying interactivity rather than animating it.
sound: A light tick per row landing, a slightly brighter tick on the pinned badge.
prompt: Claim the order is fully up to the user, then build a short labelled list top to bottom, a couple of rows marked pinned with a small badge, the rest showing a drag handle, so the list reads as yours to rearrange.
